people.name: Corinth
people.line: Ancient Greek city; recipient of Paul's epistles

people.name: Erastus
people.line: Companion of Paul; served as city treasurer in Corinth.

people.name: Miletus
people.line: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul

people.name: Trophimus
people.line: Gentile Christian from Ephesus, companion of Paul

translations.web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
translations.bsb: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
translations.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
